Title: Verify the application fails to start if the required environment variable QR_SIGNING_KEY is not set in the dev profile
Section: QR Bangla Configuration - Environment Variable Dependency
Preconditions: Application is built with the updated application-dev.yml configuration. No QR_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is set in the deployment environment.
Steps:
1. Attempt to start the application using the dev profile. 2. Observe the application startup logs or error messages.

Test Data: New configuration: qr.bangla.signing-key: "${QR_SIGNING_KEY}" (environment variable reference)
Expected Result: The application fails to start and logs an error indicating that the required environment variable QR_SIGNING_KEY is missing.

Title: Verify the application starts successfully and resolves the QR_SIGNING_KEY environment variable in the dev profile
Section: QR Bangla Configuration - Environment Variable Resolution
Preconditions: Application is built with the updated application-dev.yml configuration. QR_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is set to a valid value (e.g., "test-signing-key-12345") in the deployment environment.
Steps:
1. Start the application using the dev profile. 2. Verify the application starts without errors. 3. Check application logs or configuration endpoints to confirm the QR_SIGNING_KEY value is correctly resolved.

Test Data: New configuration: qr.bangla.signing-key: "${QR_SIGNING_KEY}" (resolved to "test-signing-key-12345")
Expected Result: The application starts successfully, and the QR_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is correctly resolved and used in the configuration.

Title: Verify the new QR Bangla configuration properties are correctly bound and accessible in the dev profile
Preconditions: Application is running with the dev profile and QR_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is set.
Steps:
1. Use the application's configuration endpoint or logs to inspect the bound properties. 2. Confirm the values for qr.bangla.guid, qr.bangla.signing-key, and qr.bangla.signature-length are as configured.

Test Data: New configuration: qr.bangla.guid: "YOUR_BANGLA_QR_GUID", qr.bangla.signing-key: "${QR_SIGNING_KEY}", qr.bangla.signature-length: 16
Expected Result: The configuration properties qr.bangla.guid, qr.bangla.signing-key, and qr.bangla.signature-length are correctly bound and accessible with their expected values.

Title: Verify a QR code can be generated for a merchant with Bangla QR configuration enabled (dev profile)
Section: QR Code Generation - Bangla QR Integration
Preconditions: Application is running with the dev profile, QR_SIGNING_KEY is set, and Bangla QR configuration is enabled.
Steps:
1. Trigger a QR code generation request for a merchant without specifying a store. 2. Observe the response status and body.

Test Data: New configuration: qr.bangla.guid: "YOUR_BANGLA_QR_GUID", qr.bangla.signature-length: 16
Expected Result: The response status code is 200 OK. The response body contains a QR code with the expected structure, including a valid qrData field that adheres to Bangla QR specifications (e.g., includes the GUID and a signature of length 16).
